policy.rule: Do not promote planning data, illustrations, envelopes, or engineering inferences to authoritative aircraft geometry. Every rendered datum must retain provenance and fidelity.

sources.title: A320 Aircraft Characteristics — Airport and Maintenance Planning (1 July 2026)
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Public A320-family planning dimensions and cargo/servicing arrangements explicitly shown in the selected publication and revision.
sources.limitations: The catalogue and ACAP are for airport and maintenance planning, not a cabin CAD model or Weight and Balance Manual. Do not infer unseen liner, window, bin, seat, or ULD cross-section coordinates.

sources.title: FAST magazine 39
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Identifies A320-family cargo options and depicts named NAS 3610/IATA ULD contours and dimensions, including LD3-45W; states an A320 arrangement of three forward and four aft ULD positions.
sources.limitations: December 2006 fleet-upgrade article, not a current aircraft-specific loading manual. Reference illustrations require scale verification and are not certified station geometry.

sources.title: Under the Spotlights
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Supports a layered passenger-window asset: typical inner and outer stretched-acrylic panes in a seal, cabin-side transparent lining, retainer, and plug-type installation.
sources.limitations: Does not provide aircraft-specific aperture dimensions, belt height, pane curvature, pitch, or installation coordinates.

sources.title: Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning — Plan Manuals
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Catalogue for current public Boeing planning manuals, including 787 and legacy DC/MD types, and statement of their airport-planning scope.
sources.limitations: No universal cabin or hold contour. Cite the exact model and revision for extracted numbers; coordinate-level cabin geometry generally requires configuration-controlled data.

sources.title: Easy Access Rules for Large Aeroplanes (CS-25), CS 25.775 and AMC 25.775(d)
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Structural and high-altitude design context for windows; AMC text describes typical multi-pane cabin-window construction.
sources.limitations: Does not prescribe renderer geometry, window position, dimensions, or curvature. Verify the applicable CS-25 amendment for certification work.

sources.title: AC 25-17A Change 1 — Transport Airplane Cabin Interiors Crashworthiness Handbook
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Certification context for transport-airplane cabin interiors and occupant/restraint installations.
sources.limitations: Acceptable guidance is not mandatory and supplies no aircraft-specific seat, bin, liner, or aisle geometry.

sources.title: AC 25-21 — Certification of Transport Airplane Structure
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Historical structural-certification context; retained to document and reject an earlier research lead.
sources.limitations: Cancelled 2017-03-21. Do not use as current guidance or as a source of cabin geometry.

sources.title: ULD Regulations (ULDR)
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Authoritative catalogue route for registered ULD type codes, diagrams, characteristics, aircraft acceptability, pallet/net compatibility, markings, and operating limitations.
sources.limitations: Full normative data are licensed. The public page establishes scope but is not a dimensional dataset. Use licensed ULDR plus the applicable aircraft Weight and Balance Manual for authoritative contours and compatibility.

sources.title: What is Aircraft ULD in Air Transport?
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Public explanation that ULD markings follow IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolution 685 and the ULDR; supports label semantics.
sources.limitations: Not a dimensional or compatibility dataset. Mark diagram codes synthetic unless sourced from the solved load record.

sources.title: An Approach for Linking Heterogenous and Domain-Specific Models to Investigate Cabin System Variants
sources.owner: Mara Fuchs, Yassine Ghanjaoui, Jörn Biedermann, and Björn Nagel
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Supports stable cross-domain object IDs, a low-detail geometric model followed by high-resolution asset substitution, object-level requirements, and the regular/large/extra-large OHSC variant taxonomy.
sources.limitations: The paper publishes no dimensioned OHSC profile, attachment geometry, fuselage-liner curve, or center-bin formulation. Its silhouettes cannot be treated as aircraft geometry; provisional renderer dimensions remain ALAS assumptions.

sources.title: The Shapely User Manual
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Cartesian constructive and set-theoretic operations for offsets, intersections, containment, and clearance/collision checks.
sources.limitations: Does not validate aircraft physics or provenance and performs no coordinate-system transformations. Buffer curves are polygonal approximations controlled by resolution and tolerance.

sources.title: <clipPath> — SVG
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Defines SVG clipping for keeping decorative layers inside resolved liner and hold regions while retaining semantic vector content.
sources.limitations: Clipping changes painting, not inherent geometry. It cannot replace collision or containment validation.

sources.title: CairoSVG Documentation
sources.relevant_datum_or_use: Command-line and Python conversion of SVG 1.1 to PNG, PDF, PS, and SVG for preview and export.
sources.limitations: Output converter only. Validate supported SVG/CSS features, fonts, and golden renders on each deployment platform.

engineering_inferences.relevant_datum_or_use: Construct station-indexed containment polygons and validate SI-coordinate components before drawing.
engineering_inferences.limitations: Project architecture decision; not asserted by any aircraft manufacturer or regulator.

engineering_inferences.relevant_datum_or_use: Model side/center bins, rails, valances, PSUs, and ceiling panels as an explicit connected topology with collision and opening-sweep checks.
engineering_inferences.limitations: Generic representation until configuration-specific supplier and aircraft installation data are available.

engineering_inferences.relevant_datum_or_use: Do not resize seats, occupants, holds, or ULDs to improve appearance; expose clearance and utilization failures instead.
engineering_inferences.limitations: Renderer acceptance policy, not an external physical datum.

engineering_inferences.relevant_datum_or_use: Restrict SVG clipping to paint; evaluate containment and collision on unclipped model geometry.
engineering_inferences.limitations: Implementation rule inferred from SVG and geometry-engine semantics.
